strip_html_tags: strip HTML tags from a string and return plain text content
get_text_size: get the pixel width and height of text rendered with a given PIL font
render_text: render text centered inside a bounding box on a PIL ImageDraw with auto-scaling font size
draw_text_with_playwright: draw text into bounding boxes on an image using a headless Playwright browser screenshot
draw_text_on_image: draw multiple texts into bounding boxes on a new PIL image with font auto-sizing and optional Playwright rendering
